newsitem.title: FRANCE: GOLF-PARNEVIK LOOKS TO RYDER CUP CAPTAIN BALLESTEROS.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-PARNEVIK LOOKS TO RYDER CUP CAPTAIN BALLESTEROS.

text.p: U.S.-based Swede Jesper Parnevik would be delighted to accept a wild card selection for next year's Ryder Cup from from European captain Seve Ballesteros.
Parnevik has a dilemma because of his decision in 1994 to play full time on the U.S. Tour.

He had to surrender full membership of the European Tour because he could not play at least 11 events and is not eligible to collect qualification points even from those European tournaments he plays in.
That includies this week's Lancome Trophy at St Nom la Breteche, near Paris.
"I don't think I am going to give up the U.S. Tour and come over here just for the Ryder Cup," the 31-year-old Swede said on Thursday after a 66 gave him a share of second place.

Parnevik, runner-up in the 1994 British Open and winner of last year's Scandinavian Masters, has been in great form on the U.S. Tour with three top seven finishes in his last four events including third in the Greater Milwaukee Open.
"Seve wants me to come over here and play and qualify," he said. "It is a tough decision. He has only two wild cards and one of them will probably go to Nick (Faldo)."

"I feel so comfortable in the U.S. now," added Parnevik. "Even though I played well my first two years there I did not get the results I wanted on new courses every week with fast greens and different conditions.
"Now I am starting to feel comfortable with that type of game."
